blocks.text: Central Coquitlam homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Central Coquitlam, September 2026. Detached houses: 64 listed at month end and 9 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 36 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 14% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 52 sold over 4 months against an average of 70.0 listed, about 5.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 18 sold. Condos and townhomes: 17 sold over 4 months against an average of 36.5 listed, about 8.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 8 sold.

faq.q: Which school district and schools serve Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: School District 43 (Coquitlam). For the sample address 1169 Pinetree Way, the SD43 locator result is Glen Elementary, École Maple Creek Middle and Pinetree Secondary; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the locator.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Central Coquitlam?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Central Coquitlam is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
